scripts.typecheck: bun run types && bun run typecheck:server && bun run typecheck:app
scripts.types: mkdir -p .wrangler/types && wrangler types .wrangler/types/api.d.ts --config workers/api/wrangler.jsonc --env production --env-interface ApiEnv
scripts.registry:api:dev: bun run build && wrangler dev --config workers/api/wrangler.jsonc --env test
scripts.registry:api:deploy:test: bun run build && wrangler deploy --config workers/api/wrangler.jsonc --env test
scripts.registry:api:deploy:production: bun run build && wrangler deploy --config workers/api/wrangler.jsonc --env production
